silopolis:

More time and effort has been spent explaining why you chose to go with the initials/acronyms than would have been spent making them a little more viewer-friendly in the first place.

Not from my perspective. I pop in, amuse myself by watching everyone flog a dead horse, then post to ensure that they realize they weren't talking about what I really said, but about what their hive mind has agreed that I said. I'm just forcing them to go back to the beginning, because they start accusing me of things I never did. They communally agree that I did it, so I must have.

I find threads like these highly amusing. I really am just laughing at everyone posting about this. They have missed something, because they have unreasonable expectations and feel they do not need to pay any attention. I just wonder if any of them are going to stop trying to tell me what to do long enough to see what's at the end of their own nose.
